description: full-service event rental company established in 1972, specializing in high-quality items and equipment for special events. They serve the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic regions along the East Coast, offering an extensive selection of furniture, linens, and decor. The company is dedicated to helping clients bring their unique event visions to life with professional customer care and design support. With its main facility in Teterboro, New Jersey, and a showroom in New York City, it remains a leading provider in the event services industry.
